security_audit.summary: Most static external command and system reconnaissance alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, parameters, and Figma identifiers. The meaningful risk is third-party Rube MCP connectivity with Figma authorization, which needs clear permission and data-handling guidance.

remediation.issue: Third-party MCP endpoint handles Figma authorization.
remediation.suggestion: Document required permissions, provider trust assumptions, and user confirmation before exports, downloads, comments, or team browsing.

remediation.issue: External MCP endpoint is hardcoded in setup guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to verify the endpoint domain and use organization-approved MCP configuration before granting Figma access.

remediation.issue: Markdown formatting triggers external command detections.
remediation.suggestion: No executable code was found, but scanner noise can be reduced by documenting tool names without shell-like fenced blocks where possible.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Figma connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `figma`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `file_key`: File key from URL (e.g., 'abc123XYZ' from figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/...)
- `depth`: Tree traversal depth (2 for pages and top-level children)
- `simplify`: True for AI-friendly format (70%+ size reduction)
- `ids` must be a comma-separated string, not an array
- Response data may be in `data_preview` instead of `data`
- `images`: Array of {node_id, file_name, format} for downloads
- `tokens`: Full tokens object from extraction (for Tailwind conversion)
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
2. Extract file_key, node_id, team_id from response

content.user_title: Automate Figma Workflows With Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Design handoff often requires repeated file inspection, export, and token extraction. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for Figma tasks.
actual_capabilities: Connects to Rube MCP and checks Figma connection status.
Discovers Figma file, node, team, and project identifiers from URLs.
Retrieves file JSON, nodes, components, component sets, and styles.
Renders and downloads selected nodes as PNG, JPG, SVG, or PDF.
Extracts design tokens and converts them to Tailwind configuration.
Lists, adds, and reviews comments, reactions, versions, projects, and files.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Figma connection.
Only supports Figma Design files for file JSON workflows.
Large node requests can exceed payload limits and need narrower scope.
Team IDs must be supplied from Figma URLs.

use_cases.title: Design Handoff Review
use_cases.description: Inspect a Figma file, collect key nodes, and export assets for implementation planning.

use_cases.title: Design Token Extraction
use_cases.description: Extract colors, typography, spacing, and variables, then prepare Tailwind configuration guidance.

use_cases.title: Comment and Version Audit
use_cases.description: Review file comments, reactions, and version history before release or stakeholder review.

prompt_templates.title: Check Figma Connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Figma automation skill to confirm Rube MCP is available and verify my Figma connection status.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a File
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Figma URL: [URL]. Discover the file and node IDs, then summarize pages, top-level frames, and published components.

prompt_templates.title: Export Selected Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: From this Figma file: [URL], find these node names: [NODES]. Render them as PNG at 2x and prepare download steps.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Tokens for Tailwind
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Figma file: [URL]. Extract design tokens, include variables, and convert the full token set to Tailwind guidance.

output_examples.input: Inspect a Figma design file and identify components for handoff.
output: Detected the file key and normalized selected node IDs.
Summarized pages, top-level frames, and component sets.
Flagged unsupported FigJam and Slides URLs when present.

output_examples.input: Export social banner nodes from a Figma file.
output_examples.output: The workflow identifies the requested nodes, renders PNG assets at the requested scale, and prepares download guidance with file names.

output_examples.input: Extract design tokens and prepare Tailwind guidance.
output_examples.output: The workflow collects colors, typography, spacing, and variables, then maps the complete token set into Tailwind-oriented recommendations.

best_practices: Search Rube tools first so parameter schemas match the current MCP server.
Use narrow node IDs and shallow depth before requesting larger file data.
Confirm Figma permissions before comments, downloads, exports, or team browsing.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private Figma links without confirming the workspace and access scope.
Do not request whole-file JSON when a specific node or page is enough.
Do not pass partial token data into Tailwind conversion.

faq.question: What does this skill automate?
faq.answer: It guides Figma file inspection, node exports, token extraction, comments, versions, projects, and team browsing through Rube MCP.

faq.question: Does it require a Figma connection?
faq.answer: Yes. Rube MCP must be connected, and the Figma toolkit connection must show active status.

faq.question: Can it work with FigJam or Slides?
faq.answer: File JSON workflows only support Figma Design files. FigJam boards and Slides are listed as unsupported.

faq.question: Can it export images?
faq.answer: Yes. It can render selected file nodes and download PNG, JPG, SVG, or PDF outputs when the tools permit.

faq.question: Can it create Tailwind tokens?
faq.answer: Yes. It can extract Figma design tokens and guide conversion to Tailwind when the full token response is available.

faq.question: What should users verify before using it?
faq.answer: Users should verify the Rube MCP endpoint, Figma authorization scope, and whether the requested action changes or exports sensitive design data.
